author: Alex Kahn
description: A few small, broadly-useful Vue composables for AbsoluteJS apps: useHydrated (SSR hydration gate), isBrowser, useDebouncedAction, and runAsyncAction (try/catch/loading/notify wrapper with an injectable notifier). Vue is a peer dependency.
name: @absolutejs/vue-composables

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --sourcemap --external vue && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --project tsconfig.json
